description:
What this machine keeps running on lemonfiber's behalf.

Defaultable so a test can read one out of a `Result` without a branch it can
never take: a closure standing in for the impossible arm is a region no
passing run enters, and the coverage gate counts those.

caveat.description: What is true of this manager and worth knowing before it is relied on.

changed.description: What this run changed, where it was asked to change something.

commands.description: Every long-running command there is, hosted or not.

instruction.description: What to do instead, where lemonfiber cannot configure this platform.

manager.description: The service manager this platform has, or the absence of one.

rehearsed.description:
Whether this was a rehearsal: what would have happened, with none of it done.

Said in a field of its own so that a rehearsal is never told from the real run by
its wording alone.
